headline: Nathalie Saad: pulmonologist elected first woman to lead Collège des médecins du Québec
dek: The University of Ottawa Faculty of Medicine congratulated its alumna Dr Nathalie Saad, a pulmonologist, on her election as the first woman to head the Collège des médecins du Québec.
body:
The University of Ottawa Faculty of Medicine announced on X that Dr Nathalie Saad, one of its alumnae (MD 2006), has been elected as the first woman to lead the Collège des médecins du Québec.

According to the faculty, Dr Saad is a pulmonologist and Vice-Dean of Student Affairs at McGill University. It said she is dedicated to improving access to care, addressing the needs of an aging population, and adapting medical practice in response to emerging technologies.

The faculty described the election as "a remarkable achievement for our alumna and a significant milestone for women in medical leadership". It pointed readers to an article in Le Devoir for further coverage.
key_quote: A remarkable achievement for our alumna and a significant milestone for women in medical leadership!
